notes: Aggregates only current 2025 Form 1099-OID box-5 market-discount members under the dedicated closed family. This symbol never publishes to, or stands behind, Form 1099-INT box 10, Form 1099-OID box 1, or total taxable interest. Waits for tax.us.2025.f1099oid.b5 to be confirmed closed (attachment-closure). Core v68 (interest-cents): this subtotal no longer rounds. It publishes the sum with cents, which is the figure the Schedule B Part I attachment's itemized rows add to, so the attachment ties out when a member carries cents. Line 2b (rule.form1040-line2b-rounded) rounds the total once (i1040gi-2025 'Rounding Off to Whole Dollars': include cents when adding amounts and round off only the total). Its closure guard is unchanged.
